title: kbmon --status all's '+N more' counts hidden lines, not the items it cuts, so 'Coord: 4 live claims' shows two and '+5 more'
goal: Where `--status all` cuts a topic to ALL_LINES lines, the cut line reads `+N more (A KIND, B KIND): python3 _tools/kbmon.py --status TOPIC` with counts that sum to N; the cut line of the coord topic names its hidden lines as claims, drift, asks and settings; the cut lines of the Sessions and Load topics use the same form

run: import re,subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--status','all','--timeout','60'],capture_output=True,text=True);sys.exit(r.returncode not in (0,1) or bool(re.search(r'\+[0-9]+ more: python3 _tools/kbmon.py --status coord',r.stdout)))

import atexit,shutil,tempfile
_m=tempfile.mkdtemp
def _d(*a,**k):
 d=_m(*a,**k);atexit.register(shutil.rmtree,d,True);return d
tempfile.mkdtemp=_d
import re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import mon_status
def ok(data):
    return {"state": "ok", "data": data}
claims = [{"key": f"item/ST-aaaaaaa{n}", "holder": f"s-00000{n}", "left_s": 600, "budget_usd": None, "spend_usd": None, "over_budget": False} for n in range(4)]
procs = [{"pid": 100 + n, "age_s": 120, "class": "orphan", "checkout": "clone", "session": None, "item": None} for n in range(2)]
drift = {"count": 1, "items": [{"item": "ST-aaaaaaa0", "title": "T", "state": "working", "git": "landed", "age_s": 60}]}
snap = {"taken": "2026-11-08T12:00:00Z", "panels": {
    "coord": ok({"claims": claims, "asks": [{"id": "A1", "since": "", "text": ""}], "asks_open": 2,
                 "settings": {"strategy.working": {"value": "after", "source": "settings.json"}}}),
    "sessions": ok({"procs": procs, "sessions": [], "drift": drift, "stalled": [], "waits": [], "overlaps": []}),
    "querylog": ok({}), "sprint": ok({"sprints": []}),
    "host": ok({"load": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0], "cores": 4, "disk": {"free_pct": 20}, "cpu_basis": "recent",
                "groups": [{"kind": "kbmon", "cpu": 50.0, "procs": 1, "clone": None}, {"kind": "claude", "cpu": 10.0, "procs": 2, "clone": None}]})}}
lines = mon_status.answer(snap, "all")["lines"]
print("\n".join(lines))
cuts = {m.group(3): m for m in (re.fullmatch(r"\s*\+(\d+) more \(([^)]*)\): python3 _tools/kbmon\.py --status (\w+)", x) for x in lines) if m}
def sums(m):
    parts = [re.fullmatch(r"(\d+) (.+)", p) for p in m.group(2).split(", ")]
    return all(parts) and sum(int(p.group(1)) for p in parts) == int(m.group(1))
bad = [t for t in ("coord", "sessions", "load") if t not in cuts or not sums(cuts[t])]
coord = cuts.get("coord")
bad += [] if coord and all(w in coord.group(2) for w in ("2 claims", "1 drift", "1 asks", "1 settings")) else ["coord kinds"]
print(bad)
sys.exit(not not bool(bad))
